videos.title: Google’s New Antigravity For Knowledge Work
summary: Paul J Lipsky walks through his everyday setup for Google Antigravity, the agentic desktop and web app Google built around its Gemini 4 Neon model, in a video sponsored by Hyperagent.

He covers how he organizes work into projects, chooses which model to run tasks against, keeps local files and a financial/business dashboard current, connects other Google apps, and sets up automations.

The video closes with voice and mobile access plus the limitations he has run into using Antigravity day to day, continuing Lipsky's recurring format of hands-on walkthroughs of AI productivity tools, this time centered on Google's Gemini-powered platform rather than Claude, ChatGPT, or Grok.

videos.title: The Dangerous Cost of Taking Down The Somali Fraud Empire | David Hoch Interview
summary: Nick Shirley interviews David Hoch about his years-long effort to expose a massive Minnesota fraud network built around fake daycares and feeding programs, much of it tied to the state's Somali community.

Hoch recounts how he found empty daycare facilities while having only 20 followers, the death threats and family fallout that followed, and the eventual response once CNN and Governor Tim Walz's office were forced to act, with roughly 400 daycares shut down and $185 million frozen.

The conversation widens into the political and legal aftermath, including a $7.2 million guilty verdict a judge overturned, a federal fraud crackdown led by JD Vance, and criticism of local officials; no AI tool or technology is discussed anywhere in the interview.
